@zmwaris1 You can just submit a PR and link to this issue.  We don't assign in general.
Hi @bashtage, I added the two missing parameters  in this PR:  https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/pull/49168

review_comments: @jbrockmendel should the `TimedeltaIndex` constructor accept `closed`? It appears not to do anything with the argument
Same was noticed in pandas-stubs by @Dr-Irv.  We thought deprecation or just removal made the most sense.
Should I remove the closed parameter then?
Ideally remove and deprecate closed using `@deprecate_kwarg`

I tried to find some other function that uses `@depreceate_kwarg` but couldn't find any, would it be something like this?
```
@deprecate_kwarg
closed : str, default None
    Make the interval closed with respect to the given frequency to
    the 'left', 'right', or both sides (None).
```
You can reference the `@deprecate_kwarg` usage from this older PR: https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/pull/47912
